description: An exceptional opportunity to acquire a substantial Victorian home packed with period character, sea views, and versatile space. Crucially, the ground-floor configuration allows for an independent, self-contained flat featuring its own private rear entry—ideal as a secondary income source (suitable for Registered / Non-Qualified tenants), a multi-generational living suite, or a self-contained home office/studio.

Features include a communal gym/workout room and office space for home working.
